MethodDescription: Indicator of the status of the enclosure door recorded by a Campbell Scientific 18166.

MethodDescription: Reference ET for grass/short grass. Prior to 9/18/15, determined by the RefET program using the ASCE Penman-Montieth Standardized Form. After 9/18/15, determined by the ASCE Standardized Reference Evapotranspiration equation (Etsz in CRBasic). Inputs are air temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, solar radiation, and spatial references.

MethodDescription: Reference ET for alfalfa/tall grass. Prior to 9/18/15, determined by the RefET program using the ASCE Penman-Montieth Standardized Form. After 9/18/15, determined by the ASCE Standardized Reference Evapotranspiration equation (Etsz in CRBasic). Inputs are air temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, solar radiation, and spatial references.
MethodDescription: Indicator as to whether the heater is on or off.
MethodDescription: Counter of the number of measurements included in the determination of average snow depth (0-6).

MethodDescription: Snow depth measured using a Judd Communications ultrasonic snow depth sensor.  Calculated as the average of six measurements with outliers (>90% of offset or <10) excluded.  Averaging was implemented in late 2013 and early 2014 (site dependent).
MethodDescription: Offset that reflects the difference between the Judd Snow Sensor and the ground surface. Constant value is manually adjusted to account for sensor drift.
MethodDescription: Air temperature measured using a Judd snow sensor.

MethodDescription: Net radiation determined by the difference between Incoming(Shortwave + Longwave) and Outgoing (Shortwave + Longwave). All quantities measured by the Huskeflux NR01 radiometer and corrected for temperature.
